# Descriptions
@@ 2
Caster learns nature, history, and value of any 1 plant.
@@ 3
Caster can understand the nature, origin, and value of any 1 herb; if the
plant is not an herb, no information will be related.
@@ 5
Caster learns the nature, history, and origin of any 1 stone.
@@ 6
Caster can increase speed of growth for any 1 species of plant within the
radius by 10 times.
@@ 7
Allows caster to understand and “speak” the language of any 1 animal species.
@@ 9
Caster can control the actions of any 1 animal.
@@ 10
Caster can monitor animate activity in the area (e.g., he will be aware of
subtle movements). For the duration of the spell, the caster cannot move.
@@ 11
Allows caster to understand and “speak” the language of any 1 plant species.
@@ 12
As Animal Mastery I, except caster can control 3 animals.
@@ 13
Caster can understand and/or visualize the thoughts and emotions of any 1
animal.
@@ 14
Caster can control the automatic and/ or mental processes of any 1 plant.
Caster can also control the plant’s movements. Note that this spell does not
allow movement beyond normal allowances.
@@ 15
Caster can communicate with any 1 stone if it possesses any animate qualities
(e.g., caster could speak to a holy stone that possesses an intelligence).
@@ 16
Caster can grow an herb by planting the proper seed. The herb is
sterile-growth takes 1-10 rounds.
@@ 18
As Animal Mastery I, except caster can control 5 animals.
@@ 19
As Plant Control I, except caster can control any 3 plants.
@@ 20
As Nature’s Awareness I, except that the radius is 500'.
@@ 25
Caster can understand and/or visualize the thoughts and emotions of any 1
animal, plant, stone, or dead organic object. The caster can change targets
once per round.
@@ 30
As Animal Mastery I, except caster can control all of the animals of a given
species within a range equal to 10' x his level (e.g., at 30th level you could
control all of the ferrets or minks within 300').
@@ 50
As Animal Mastery I, except duration is permanent and concentration is not
required. At a given time, there may only be 1 animal controlled by caster
through use of this spell.
